Convection.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

Concussion.text: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Shock spells by 1%.

Earth's Grasp.text: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

Elemental Warding.text: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost and Nature effects by 4%.

Call of Flame.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems by 5%.

Elemental Focus.text: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Reverberation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

Call of Thunder.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by an additional 1%.

Improved Fire Totems.text: Reduces the delay before your Fire Nova Totem activates by 1 sec. and decreases the threat generated by your Magma Totem by 25%.

Eye of the Storm.text: Gives you a 33% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking dam

Elemental Devastation.text: Your offensive spell crits will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 3% for 10 sec.

Storm Reach.text: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3 yards.

Elemental Fury.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing, Magma, and Fire Nova Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

Lightning Mastery.text: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.2 sec.

Elemental Mastery.text: When activated, this spell gives your next Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell a 100% critical strike chance and reduces the mana cost by 100%.

Shield Specialization.text: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and increases the amount blocked by 5%.

Guardian Totems.text: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

Thundering Strikes.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with your weapon attacks by 1%.

Improved Ghost Wolf.text: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 1 sec.

Improved Lightning Shield.text: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

Enhancing Totems.text: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by 8%.

Two-Handed Axes and Maces.text: Allows you to use Two-Handed Axes and Two-Handed Maces.

Anticipation.text: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%.

Flurry.text: Increases your attack speed by 10% for your next 3 swings after dealing a critical strike.

Toughness.text: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

Improved Weapon Totems.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Windfury Totem by 15% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Totem by 6%.

Elemental Weapons.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

Parry.text: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

Weapon Mastery.text: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 2%.

Stormstrike.text: Gives you an extra attack. In addition, the next 2 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

Improved Healing Wave.text: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

Tidal Focus.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 1%.

Improved Reincarnation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min and increases the amount of health and mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

Ancestral Healing.text: Increases your target's armor value by 8% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

Totemic Focus.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems by 5%.

Nature's Guidance.text: Increases your chance to hit with melee attacks and spells by 1%.

Healing Focus.text: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

Totemic Mastery.text: The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

Healing Grace.text: Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 5%.

Restorative Totems.text: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring and Healing Stream Totems by 5%.

Tidal Mastery.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing and lightning spells by 1%.

Healing Way.text: Your Healing Wave spells have a 33% chance to increase the effect of subsequent Healing Wave spells on that target by 6% for 15 sec. This effect will stack up to 3 times.

Nature's Swiftness.text: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Purification.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 2%.

Mana Tide Totem.text: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 170 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 20 yards.
